d: What is chaos theory? In this video, we explain chaos theory in simple words — from the cake baking analogy (why tiny unnoticed factors ruin the result) to the butterfly effect, deterministic systems, sensitivity to initial conditions, and why weather forecasts can never be perfectly accurate. Learn how French mathematician Henri Poincaré laid the foundation for chaos theory, and how it applies to weather forecasting, stock market crashes, and even pandemic spread.
